scientific_limitations: Integral homology and primitive inclusion of a single-vertex puncture at exactly seven ground points; not a homotopy-wedge or all-parameter theorem. A published ambient homology computation is credited, not claimed new. Closest accessible primary full text compared; repository summaries are not substitutes for inaccessible full source texts.
title: Integral vertex-puncture homology of the seven-point triple-Kneser independence complex
